# Sekkingstad

|elevation_m            = 17
|elevation_footnotes    = }}
Sekkingstad is a village in Øygarden Municipality in Vestland county, Norway. It is situated on the west side of the island of Sotra. Sekkingstad is the site of the fish factory Vågen Seafood. The  tall mountain Saufjellet lies just northeast of the village.
The  village has a population (2025) of 679 and a population density of .
